title: I am the light of the world
description: Jesus declares himself to be the light of the world in the temple and comes into conflict with the Pharisees over his testimony and origin. He speaks of the Father who sent him, about the truth that sets free, and about how those who sin are slaves to sin. The discussion intensifies when Jesus says they have the devil as their father, and culminates in his statement: "Before Abraham was born, I am." Then they pick up stones to stone him, but Jesus hides himself and goes out of the temple.
